# Exit codes

<p class="cli-lead">Stable exit codes, so scripts and CI can react to what went wrong.</p>

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `0` | Success |
| `1` | General error |
| `2` | Wrong usage: unknown flag, missing argument |
| `3` | Not signed in, or the token expired. Run `clavis login`. |
| `4` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this |
| `5` | Not found: organization, project, environment or key |
| `6` | Validation failed (`clavis check`) |
| `7` | Leak found (`clavis scan`) |

`clavis run` and `clavis lease run` exit with your command's own exit
code.
